title: OneDrive and SharePoint: respond to access requests in the Share dialog
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents a sensitivity-label PowerShell equivalent for owners-only sharing, although the table says automation is not documented. The description of who can process the existing Access Requests list also omits the Owners group's required Full Control permission. The roadmap facts and the printed sharing paths and audit search command are supported.

claims.claim: Owners-only file, folder and site sharing is set in the site via gear icon > Site permissions > Sharing settings > Change how members can share > Only site owners can share files, folders, and the site.
claims.quote: In the site, select the gear icon, and then select Site permissions. Under Sharing settings, select Change how members can share. Select Only site owners can share files, folders, and the site.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented automation for owners-only file, folder and site sharing.
claims.quote: Only site owners can share files, folders, and the site. | MemberShareNone ... Set-Label -Identity 8faca7b8-8d20-48a3-8ea2-0f96310a848e -AdvancedSettings @{MembersCanShare="MemberShareNone"}
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api with kind powershell, call 'Set-Label -Identity <label> -AdvancedSettings @{MembersCanShare="MemberShareNone"}', and docs https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/sensitivity-labels-teams-groups-sites. Qualify the row note: 'This automation configures a sensitivity label; site settings take effect when that label is applied to a container that supports sensitivity labels.' Cite that page and make the rendered automation cell match. Do not restore Set-SPOSite -DisableSharingForNonOwners as a file-and-folder equivalent.

claims.claim: The owners-only sharing control is not confirmed to govern the new dialog.
claims.quote: Site permissions can be restricted so that only site owners can share files and folders. In this case, direct access and Specific people link sharing by site members goes to site owner for approval.
claims.fix: Replace 'Not confirmed to govern the new dialog.' with 'Site permissions can be restricted so that only site owners can share files and folders; direct access and Specific people link sharing by site members goes to the site owner for approval.' Keep the separate open question about how the new dialog presents approvals.

claims.claim: The site's request-access setting is reached via gear icon > Site permissions > Sharing settings > Change how members can share > Allow access requests.
claims.quote: In the site, select the gear icon, and then select Site permissions. Under Sharing settings, select Change how members can share. Turn off Allow access requests, and then select Save.
